automations.name: New Lead Follow-Up
automations.summary: When someone submits the lead form on your website, this follows up right away by email and text, connects your office by phone if they don't reply, and checks in again the next day.
glance: Someone submits the lead form on your website
1 call to connect with the new lead
The next day, after the check-in text

steps.title: Someone submits your website lead form
steps.body: The follow-up starts when someone submits the lead (intake) form on your website.
steps.note: All six of these automations are still in Draft in GHL, so nothing is being sent yet. They'll go live once you approve. We're connecting this trigger to your website lead form (it was set up for an offer form and a Facebook lead form from a template).

steps.title: The lead is added to your lead board
steps.body: They're added to the Marketing Pipeline as a New Lead, and also start the Long-Term Nurture emails (automation 5).

steps.title: Email 1: Thanks for contacting us

email.subject: Thanks for claiming our offer [First name]!
email.body:
Thanks for claiming our [Promotion name] promotion [First name]!

We're looking forward to seeing you. Be sure to check out our calendar to schedule your appointment: [Booking link]

We also shot you a text if you have any questions in the meantime.

Sralla Family Law, PLLC

steps.note: This wording still talks about “claiming our offer” and a “promotion” from the template. We suggest something like “Thanks for submitting your intake form. We're looking forward to speaking with you.” Use Edit the wording to send the version you prefer.

steps.title: Text 1: Thanks for contacting us
steps.sms:
Hi [First name], thanks for claiming our [Promotion name] promotion - Have you worked with a lawyer on this issue in the past?

- Sralla Family Law, PLLC
steps.note: This first text has no opt-out wording (“Reply STOP to opt out”), which carriers expect on the first message.

steps.when: If they reply and want to book
steps.gap: Waits up to 2 minutes for a reply
steps.title: Text 2: If they reply and want to book
steps.sms: Got it, so you know a little about what to expect. And just as a reminder: if you haven't already, be sure to schedule an appointment on our calendar here: [Booking link] You can also call us directly at [Office phone]
steps.body: When someone replies, they move to Hot Lead on your lead board. If their reply shows they want to book, they get this text.

steps.when: If they reply but aren't ready
steps.title: Text 2: If they reply but aren't ready to book
steps.sms: No problem. The next step is to book a time to come in - grab a spot that works for you here: [Booking link]

steps.when: If there's no reply after 2 minutes
steps.gap: If there's no reply after 2 minutes
steps.title: Your office is connected to the lead
steps.body: Your office phone rings with the message “A new lead has been generated. Their name is [Contact name]. Press any key to connect with [First name].” Pressing a key calls the lead.

steps.title: A recorded voicemail is left
steps.body: A pre-recorded voicemail is dropped on the lead's phone.
steps.note: We couldn't see a recording attached to this step. Please send us the voicemail you'd like to use, or we can help you record one.

steps.title: Text 3: Any questions?
steps.sms: Hi [First name], just checking back to see if you're ready to book an appointment so we can apply your discount. Are there any questions we can answer for you in the meantime? - Sralla Family Law, PLLC
steps.note: This mentions “apply your discount”. If you don't offer a discount, we'll remove that part.

steps.title: The follow-up ends
steps.body: The lead leaves this automation. They keep getting the Long-Term Nurture emails until they're marked as hired.

questions.text: Is there an offer, such as a free consultation?
questions.why: The current texts and email mention a promotion and a discount, which came from a template.

questions.text: Who should get the call when a new lead doesn't reply?
questions.why: Right now the call goes to your main office line.

automations.name: Consultation Confirmation + Reminders
automations.summary: When a consultation is confirmed, this sends a confirmation email, then reminders 24 hours and 1 hour before.
glance: A consultation is confirmed in your main calendar

steps.title: A consultation is confirmed
steps.body: Starts when an appointment is confirmed in your main booking calendar.
steps.note: All six of these automations are still in Draft in GHL, so nothing is being sent yet. They'll go live once you approve.

steps.title: The new-lead follow-up stops
steps.body: The lead leaves the New Lead Follow-Up and moves to New Booking on your lead board.
steps.note: They don't leave the Long-Term Nurture emails (automation 5), so they'll keep getting marketing emails after booking. See Question 1.

steps.title: Email 1: Your consultation is confirmed

email.subject: Show Room Appointment Confirmation
email.body:
Hi [First name],

Your appointment has been confirmed for [Appointment date] at [Appointment time] [Time zone]

Let us know if you have any questions in the meantime 👍

Sralla Family Law, PLLC
[Office address]

Add to Google calendar | Add to Outlook
Cancel | Reschedule

steps.note: “Show Room” came from a template and doesn't fit a law firm. We suggest “Your consultation is confirmed”.

steps.title: Email 2: Your consultation is in 24 hours

email.subject: Your Showroom Visit is in 24 Hours!
email.body:
Hi [First name],

Just a friendly reminder that your Showroom Appointment is in 24 Hours.

We look forward to seeing you then!

Sralla Family Law, PLLC
[Office address]

Add to google calendar | Add to outlook
Cancel | Reschedule

steps.note: “Showroom” appears in the subject and body. We'll change it to “consultation” unless you prefer other wording.

steps.title: Email 3: Your consultation is in one hour

email.subject: [First name] your Showroom Visit appointment is in one hour!
email.body:
Hi [First name],

Just a friendly reminder that your Showroom Visit appointment is in one hour.

We look forward to seeing you!

Sralla Family Law, PLLC
[Office address]

Add to google calendar | Add to outlook
Cancel | Reschedule

steps.note: “Showroom Visit” again. We'll change it to “consultation”.

steps.title: Text 1: Your consultation is in one hour
steps.sms: Hi [First name], just a friendly reminder that your Show Room Visit is in one hour. Please confirm you're still available by replying YES - Sralla Family Law, PLLC
steps.note: “Show Room Visit” should be “consultation”. This also asks for a YES reply, but nothing happens when they reply.

steps.title: The reminders end
steps.body: The lead leaves this automation at the consultation time.

questions.text: Should the Long-Term Nurture emails stop once someone books a consultation?
questions.why: Right now they keep going after booking.

questions.text: Are consultations in person, by phone or by video?
questions.why: The reminders include your office address. Phone or video consultations need different details.

questions.text: What should happen when a lead replies YES to the 1-hour text?
questions.why: Nothing is set up to handle the reply.

automations.name: Missed Consultation Follow-Up
automations.summary: When a lead misses their consultation, this sends a reschedule email and text straight away, then one more text the next day if they haven't replied.
glance: An appointment is marked No-show in your main calendar
The next day, or as soon as they reply

steps.title: A lead misses their consultation
steps.body: Starts when an appointment in your main calendar is marked No-show.
steps.note: All six of these automations are still in Draft in GHL, so nothing is being sent yet. They'll go live once you approve.

steps.title: Email 1: Let's get you rescheduled

email.subject: Let's get you rescheduled [First name]!
email.body:
Hi [First name],

Sorry you weren't able to make our show room visit - let's get you rescheduled!

You can book another day/time that will work for you by clicking here: [Booking link]

We look forward to seeing with you!

Sralla Family Law, PLLC
[Office address]

steps.note: “show room visit” should be “consultation”, and “seeing with you” should be “seeing you”.

steps.title: Text 1: Let's get you rescheduled
steps.sms:
Hi [First name]! Sorry you weren't able to make our show room visit - let's get you rescheduled!

You can book another day/time that will work for you by clicking here: [Booking link]

We look forward to seeing you! - Sralla Family Law, PLLC
steps.note: “show room visit” should be “consultation”.

steps.gap: 1 day later, if they haven't replied
steps.title: Text 2: Checking back in
steps.sms: Hi [First name], just wanted to check back to see if we can get you rescheduled or if you had any questions we can help with - Sralla Family Law, PLLC

steps.title: The follow-up ends
steps.body: The lead leaves this automation. It also stops early as soon as they reply.

questions.text: Should your team be alerted when someone misses a consultation?
questions.why: Right now nobody on your team is notified.

automations.name: Review Request When Hired
automations.summary: When a lead is marked Won (hired), this stops the marketing emails, sends a review request by email and text, and reminds your team 3 days later to check whether a review came in.
glance: A lead is marked Won on your lead board
1 review request email, 1 review request text
Day 3, after your team is reminded

steps.title: A lead is marked Won
steps.body: Starts when a lead in the Marketing Pipeline is marked Won.
steps.note: All six of these automations are still in Draft in GHL, so nothing is being sent yet. They'll go live once you approve.

steps.title: The Long-Term Nurture emails stop
steps.body: The client leaves the Long-Term Nurture emails (automation 5).

steps.title: Review request email
steps.body: Your standard review request email is sent, with a link to leave a Google review.
steps.note: This uses the review request set up in GHL's Reputation settings. We'll add the exact wording here for you to review.

steps.title: Review request text
steps.body: Your standard review request text is sent, with a link to leave a Google review.
steps.note: This also uses the wording from your Reputation settings. We'll add it here for you to review.

steps.title: Your team is reminded to check for a review
steps.body: Everyone on your team gets an email: “Has [Contact name] left a review yet? If [Contact name] hasn't yet left a review, please follow up manually.”

steps.title: The review request ends
steps.body: The client leaves this automation.

questions.text: When should a client be asked for a review?
questions.why: Today it's sent as soon as they're marked Won, which is often the day they hire you, before any work is done. Many firms wait until the matter is resolved.

questions.text: Who should get the 3-day review reminder?
questions.why: Right now it goes to every user in your account.

automations.name: Long-Term Nurture
automations.summary: New leads who don't book straight away get one email a week for four weeks, each on a different area of your practice.
glance: A new lead comes in through automation 1
After the fourth email, or when marked Won

steps.title: A new lead starts the nurture emails
steps.body: Leads join this automation from the New Lead Follow-Up (automation 1).
steps.note: All six of these automations are still in Draft in GHL, so nothing is being sent yet. They'll go live once you approve.

questions.text: Which practice areas should these emails cover?

automations.name: Stale Leads Clean-Up
automations.summary: Leads that sit in New Lead, Hot Lead or New Booking for 7 days without any activity are marked Abandoned, so your lead board stays current.
glance: A lead has no activity for 7 days

steps.title: A lead has had no activity for 7 days
steps.body: Starts when a lead has sat in New Lead, Hot Lead or New Booking for 7 days with nothing happening.
steps.note: All six of these automations are still in Draft in GHL, so nothing is being sent yet. They'll go live once you approve.

steps.title: The lead is marked Abandoned
steps.body: The lead's status changes to Abandoned on your Marketing Pipeline.
steps.note: This step doesn't have a pipeline stage set, and your pipeline has no Abandoned stage. We'll make sure it updates the status correctly before going live.

steps.title: Done
steps.body: Nothing is sent to the lead.

questions.why: Family law clients often take longer to decide.

questions.text: Should booked leads be marked Abandoned after 7 days?
questions.why: Someone with a consultation booked 2 weeks out would be marked Abandoned before they meet you.
